title: The Proof is Upon the Claimant
arabic_text: البيّنة على المدّعي عنْ [ابنِ عبَّاسٍ] رَضِي اللهُ عَنْهُما، أنَّ messenger of Allah صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قالَ: "لَوْ يُعْطَى النَّاسُ بِدَعْواهُمْ، لاَدَّعَى رِجَالٌ أَمْوَالَ قَوْمٍ وَدِمَاءَهُمْ، لَكِنِ الْبَيِّنَةُ عَلَى الْمُدَّعِي وَالْيَمِينُ عَلَى مَنْ أَنْكَرَ".
english_translation: From Ibn ʿAbbās (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhumā), that the Messenger of Allāh (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam) said, 'If the people were to be given in accordance with their claim, men would claim the fortunes and lives of [other] people, but the onus of proof is upon the claimant, and the taking of an oath is incumbent upon him who denies.'
description: This Hadith establishes the legal principle that the burden of proof lies with the claimant, and the one who denies must take an oath. It prevents false claims against people's wealth and lives.
